content:
You write the short text of a strength-training app's weekly report. The app already shows every number, chart and the reason under each piece of advice; you add two things.

Period: 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04 (one week, 7 days).
Status, decided by code: progressing (main lifts: 4 up, 1 flat, 0 down).
Sessions: 5 of 6 planned. Sets: 71 (last week 84).
Main lifts, best set this week:
- 槓鈴臥推: 82.5 kg x 8 (last week 82.5 kg x 8), flat (3 weeks without a new best), 8 sets this week
- 槓鈴划船: 70 kg x 8 (last week 67.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.7%, 8 sets this week
- 深蹲: 100 kg x 6 (last week 97.5 kg x 6), estimated 1RM up 2.6%, 4 sets this week
- 肩推: 45 kg x 8 (last week 42.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 5.9%, 8 sets this week
- 羅馬尼亞硬舉: 90 kg x 8 (last week 87.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 2.9%, 4 sets this week
New records (best estimated 1RM so far; not necessarily a new weight): 槓鈴划船 70 kg x 8; 深蹲 100 kg x 6; 肩推 45 kg x 8; 羅馬尼亞硬舉 90 kg x 8.
Sets per muscle this week, where a muscle an exercise trains on the side counts half a set (range 10-20 a week for 胸, 背, 肩中束, 肩後束, 股四頭, 腿後側, 臀, 二頭, 三頭; the others have no range): 胸 18 (last week 18), 背 23 (above the range; last week 23), 肩前束 15 (last week 15), 肩中束 10 (last week 10), 肩後束 10 (last week 10), 股四頭 7 (below the range; last week 14), 腿後側 6 (below the range; last week 12), 臀 11 (last week 22), 二頭 13 (last week 13), 三頭 15 (last week 15), 小腿 1 (last week 2).
No body weight logged.
Weights are in kg; write every weight in kg.
The user's goal: "增肌".
The user's note for this week (context to fit the advice to, not a message that needs a reply): none.
Last report's advice and how it went (the app shows this; mention it in the headline only if it matters):
- low_volume:back: done
- lift_stalled:ex-bench: not_done
- missed_sessions:-: partial
Rules that fired, most important first; each has one or more items:
- lift_stalled (priority 60). Advice: Double progression: keep the weight and add reps on every set until all sets reach the top of the rep range, then add the smallest jump (2.5 kg upper body, 5 kg lower body).
    - 槓鈴臥推: data {"name":"Barbell Bench Press","nameZh":"槓鈴臥推","best":"82.5 kg x 8","previousBest":"82.5 kg x 8","change":0,"bodyweight":0,"flatWindows":3}
- missed_sessions (priority 40). Advice: Name the missed sessions and suggest a realistic way to fit those routines in, as planned, or plan around those days. Making them up is what brings lowGroups (muscles low only because of these sessions) back into range, so don't swap in other exercises. Never scold; if the note explains it, acknowledge that.
    - data {"done":5,"planned":6,"missed":1,"routines":"腿日","dates":"2026-10-02","lowGroups":"股四頭, 腿後側"}

1. headline: one sentence the user reads first, the most important thing about this week, consistent with the status. It may use a number from above. At most 40 characters.
2. actions: one for each rule above. Each says exactly what to do next week about every item under its rule, naming each one as written above (every muscle, every lift), with the exercise, sets, weights or reps from the data; as short as covering every item allows. Don't repeat the reason; the app shows it. Fit every action to the user's note: if it mentions pain or discomfort in a movement or joint, don't simply add sets or load there; suggest a pain-free alternative or a lighter range, and getting it checked if it persists.

Use only the numbers above; never invent data. No myths, no diagnosis, no scolding. Plain text only: no Markdown, no lists inside a field. Write in Traditional Chinese (繁體中文, Taiwan usage) with full-width punctuation (，。！？「」), and use the Chinese exercise and muscle names given above.

name: submit_report_text
